name: Sovereign Tide
description: A Vantablack Media tentpole in which the player-protagonist is a HelixCorp extraction specialist tasked with retrieving a stolen gene-sequence archive from a collapsing Shelf district. The neural-feed places you behind the eyes of a morally compromised corporate loyalist, complete with fabricated memories of a comfortable Tier 4 upbringing designed to make the player identify with corponation authority. Grossed over Φ900 million in licensed feed-hours during its first year of release.
cultural_impact: Standardized the 'corporate hero' neural-feed template that dominated mainstream immersion cinema for most of the 2190s.
story_hooks: A runner discovers their own face used without consent as the texture model for one of the film's Shelf antagonists.
A Vantablack production node containing the unedited source feed — including cut sequences depicting a real HelixCorp forced-relocation — surfaces on a pirate mesh.
The film's behavioral-conditioning subroutines are discovered to have left measurable loyalty imprints in a statistically significant portion of its audience.
